messages:
Jules (CS): Heads up — NovaPulse renewal. They want to pay by wire, procurement insists on PO/vendor code, and Legal flagged KMS/HSM clause. Onboarding is penciled for Monday but finance hold could block. Any quick wins?
Tommy (AE): On a call now. Customer uses billing entity 'NovaPulse LLC' but vendor name in their procurement system is 'NovaTech Solutions' — tax ID mismatch. They can wire if we provide invoice + banking details.
Ariana (Finance): We can accept wire, but need a formal PO + signed SOW. Also need remittance email and tax id to match invoice. Send PO to acctspayable@redwood.ai.
Nithya (Legal): Customer is asking for HSM/KMS control. Our Private deployment requires an enterprise addendum for key custody. That will add review time. Can we offer hosted onboarding as an interim so they don't lose momentum?
Jules (CS): Hosted as an interim seems reasonable. @Tommy can you check customer tolerance for a staged switch to Private later?
Tommy (AE): They prefer Private long-term but said staged approach is fine to avoid blocking onboarding. I'll push for PO + confirm vendor name mapping. ETA 48h to get PO.
Ravi (Onboarding): If we go hosted first I can kick off enablement: invites, runbook, admin walkthrough, and basic integrations. I need final seat count and admin emails to provision.
Tommy (AE): Seat count is 18. Admins: sara@novapulse.com, dan@novapulse.com
Ariana (Finance): Adding invoice/wire stub below for their AP team — share this with them exactly as-is:

```
Invoice: Redwood Inference
Invoice #: INV-2026-452
Period: 12 months
Amount: $36,000
Bank: FirstCloud Bank
Routing: ACH/WIRE details (will provide secure doc)
Remit: acctspayable@redwood.ai
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Note: PO required on remittance
```

Ariana (Finance): Once we have PO + signed SOW we'll release onboarding access. If PO is delayed beyond 7 business days, we require credit card auth or prepay.
Nithya (Legal): Also need to change signature party to 'Redwood Inc.' on the SOW and add a short addendum for key management sequencing. I'll prepare a redline and a DocuSign envelope to keep things moving.
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope created — https://docusign.com/envelope/0x7a (status: draft).
Tommy (AE): Thanks. I'll nudge the customer for PO today and confirm vendor/tax id mapping. @Ariana please confirm wire-hold policy if PO not in 48h — we need to set expectations.
Ariana (Finance): Confirmed policy: hold for up to 7 business days. After that we require prepayment or an alternate payment method. Escalate to ops if they insist on custom payment terms.
Jules (CS): Plan of record: Tommy to secure PO within 48h, Nithya to share redline and DocuSign envelope within 24h, Ravi to prepare hosted onboarding runbook and staging checklist. I'll follow up EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Tommy (AE): I'll update this thread once PO is uploaded or if we hit any procurement snafus.
Ravi (Onboarding): I'll draft the runbook and upload links to the onboarding channel — will include rollback steps for switching to Private once HSM is ready.
Nithya (Legal): If they push to require HSM before onboarding, flag me and I'll escalate to enterprise contracts team.
Jules (CS): Perfect — thanks team.
